feature_contract.scope_boundary: F11 frontend content bounds and shared R84 menu black-bar geometry only; no changes to world geometry, HUD sprite capture, lens, GOAL/+TIME, head pose, DX11/DXVK, input routing or FFB.
trace_stages: Original OutRun menu 4:3 sprite placement and geometry in UI scaling, including portrait 1200x1600 top and bottom bar construction.
D3DEndScene R84 black-bar triangles from BuildMenuBarGeometry and ImGui frontend render_shell ContentRect from BuildMenuContentBounds.
Front-end F11 ImGui window and controls mapped into existing menu content, while independent gameplay XR ScreenOverlay2D and host composition retain the full viewport.
subcomponents: Share one source-size-bounded 4:3 rectangular geometry across portrait/landscape bars and F11 frontend shell x/y/width/height.
Retain menu enablement, native 4:3, 16:9/21:9 and source-size transitions, plus full-screen external XR gameplay overlay with dedicated F11 atlas/input behavior.
Protect allocation/fallback and source-owner mutations with deterministic compilation and numerical/destructive tests.

diagnosis.original_evidence: User latest HMD test reports F11 tiny/off-position and main menu aspect issues. R84 00886 added top/bottom black bars for portrait but Overlay::content_rect still computed only lateral bars, leaving F11 window inside masked top/bottom area.
diagnosis.root_cause: Two independently computed menu content regions diverged when source aspect was portrait: GPU output drew top/bottom masked strips while F11 returned the whole source viewport.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: F11 reuses BuildMenuContentBounds derived from exactly the same BuildMenuBarGeometry vertices as the opaque D3D9Ex bars. Exact front-end 4:3 bounds use X on landscape and Y on portrait while gameplay XR F11 is untouched.
diagnosis.evidence_limits: This repairs a source-confirmed frontend portrait mismatch. It does not establish that the previously reported Quest3 gameplay F11 legibility/placement is resolved; those retain NEED_HMD_TEST.
